hero.title: Choosing a career is a family decision.
hero.description: VocaSaathi helps learners and parents explore vocational careers together using local outcome data, NSQF career pathways, and evidence-backed AI counselling.

pillars.title: What VocaSaathi does
pillars.subtitle: A structured three-step bridge between learner aspirations and family confidence.
pillars.card1Desc: Capture both the learner's interests and the parents' deepest financial, social, and safety concerns.
pillars.card2Desc: Answer tough family questions using local placement rates, median salary benchmarks, and NSQF progression ladders.
pillars.card3Desc: Seamlessly escalate unresolved dilemmas to certified vocational counsellors with pre-packaged case intelligence.
